scope: E048 horizon interpretation and E049 status at the first 200 prospective targets only

checkpoint.interpretation: An interim evidence checkpoint; the 200-target point is not a claim that the registered effect sizes have adequate power.

power_context_unchanged.source: superseded E048_POWER_AND_HORIZON.json; values remain approximations for planning, not evidence

checkpoint_decision_rule.promotion_pass: If and only if every existing E047/E049 preregistered e-process, alpha allocation, harm, stability, integrity and cutoff requirement is met, the resulting evidence may support PROSPECTIVE_VALIDATED_EDGE.
checkpoint_decision_rule.promotion_fail: At target 1445, if promotion requirements are not all met, record PROSPECTIVE_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Do not label the result REJECTED solely because the checkpoint was not passed.
checkpoint_decision_rule.rejected: REJECTED is unavailable at this checkpoint unless an explicit futility/equivalence boundary was separately registered before the first prospective outcome. No such numeric boundary is registered by this amendment; therefore this amendment does not authorize REJECTED.
checkpoint_decision_rule.weak_signal: Positive descriptive estimates that do not pass the full promotion gate remain PROSPECTIVE_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE at the 200-target checkpoint.

unchanged.e047_method: mixture e-process for bounded paired differences
